TITLE: MIss
SCENARIO: Child < 17 years with a CPP that has start date only

TITLE: MIss
SCENARIO: Child < 17 years with both a CPP and LAC that have start dates only

TITLE: MIss
SCENARIO: Child < 17 years with a CPP that has a start and end date and a LAC with only a start date. Both also have future delete dates

TITLE: Mss
SCENARIO: mother < 17 years with a LAC with no end date and also a UCPP (which must have an end date, but do not include a delete date).

TITLE: Mss
SCENARIO: Child < 17 years with a CPP with Local Authority A and also one with Local Authority B. Differing start and end dates with both start dates in the past and both end dates in the future i.e. both plans need to be active.

TITLE: Mss
SCENARIO: Child < 17 years with a CPP with Local Authority A and also one with Local Authority B. Differing start and end dates. Both start dates in the past, and one end date also in the (very recent) past i.e. only one of the plans is active.
